title: Follow Relationship Schema
description: Schema for token follow relationships stored in scene flags. Defines the contract for follow relationship objects.

leaderId.description: UUID of the leader token (token that is being followed)

followerId.description: UUID of the follower token (token that maintains distance from leader)

distance.description: Grid squares between leader and follower (center-to-center), measured via canvas.grid.measureDistance()

timestamp.description: Unix timestamp (milliseconds) when follow relationship was created
